test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: streams

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• Ocean means the mass of salt water that covers most of the surface of the earth.
 
• Stream means a body of water flowing in a channel or watercourse.
 
• Flow means to move in one direction, especially continuously and easily.
 
• Sea means a body of salt water not as large as an ocean and often nearly surrounded by land.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words 'streams' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is, **utilising natural waterways as a source of drinking water.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 2.

Complete Paragraph: *People are tired of staying indoors in artificial lights in view of the pandemic and (1) leading __a sedentary lifestyle. They are yearning to reconnect with__ (2) nature__ and ‘rewilding’ is becoming a key trend in 2021. ‘Rewilding’ is about going __(3) back__ to our ‘caveman/woman’ life by soaking in the sun, __(4) walking__ barefoot on sand and grass, drinking water from natural **__(5) streams,__** and bathing in rivers. The (6)______ of ‘outdoor living’ is all about spending time in nature, irrespective of the weather, through simple (7)______ that are free of cost, like walking, camping, or fishing with loved ones. ‘Earthing’ is a therapeutic activity, which can be performed (8)______. All you need to do is to take off your shoes and place your bare feet and hands directly on the (9)______, whether it is in a park or at the beach. Another trend is the Japanese way to beat stress – ‘forest-bathing’. You can ‘forest-bathe’ wherever there is an (10)______ of trees, including a nearby park.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• **Stream **is only used for water.
 
• **Flow **can be used for many things.
